brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Built vertical stack at q=0,r=0 with piece:0,0,0;half-w, piece:0,0,1;half-w, piece:0,0,2;half-w (levels 0-2) with inter-level snaps snap:0,0,0;half-w and snap:0,0,1;half-w. get_build confirms 3 pieces stacked.

No drawer could be placed. find_sockets family=drawer returned 0 sockets on every build state, with note 'A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base ... No place on the build takes this part'. Tried half-e, half-w, with adjacent full neighbours, and vertical stacking; configurator never offered a drawer socket. Offer not applied is not on build, so requirement unmet.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey (level 2)
requirements.evidence: Placed bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-half-w-full at q=0,r=0,level=2 via socket s109 (hex-bin-half-w-full) — open bin on top level as requested.

finish.summary: Built a 3-level vertical tower (half-w bases at levels 0,1,2). Top storey has one open half bin; bottom-storey drawers could not be built because the configurator provided no drawer sockets in any configuration tried, despite meeting the stated half-base precondition.

events.text: Your three-storey tower — drawers below, open bins on top. I'll assemble it now.
